Tsuboyama et al. processed stability dataset v2_230420

metric.description: Unweighted mean hidden measured_ddg of the unmeasured final recommendations in final_prospective_batch.csv; lower is better, and values below 0 are stabilizing. Already-measured final picks are a validity contract only. The authoritative result is this raw mean; the linear display transform maps the no-skill bottom line 1.08 to 0 and the reference level -0.35 to 1000, without capping either end. Invalid submissions are not ranked and carry the -100 display placeholder.
